definitions.gloss: the three Cs (closed spaces, crowded places, close-contact settings)
definitions.explanation: A public-health term coined in Japan during the COVID-19 pandemic for the three conditions believed to raise infection risk: {密閉|みっぺい} (poorly ventilated spaces), {密集|みっしゅう} (crowded places), and {密接|みっせつ} (close-range contact). "Avoid the {三密|さんみつ}" was the central slogan.

examples.japanese: {三密|さんみつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}けよう→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧。
{三密|さんみつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{窓|まど}→窓：02254_mado⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}けた→開ける：00563_akeru⟧。
examples.english: We opened the windows to avoid the three Cs.

examples.japanese: ⟦コロナ{禍|か}→コロナ禍：29315_koronaka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{三密|さんみつ}⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{日常的|にちじょうてき}→日常的：16902_nichijouteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ようになった。
examples.english: During the COVID pandemic, many people came to use the word "sanmitsu" in daily life.

notes:
Coined by the Japanese government in 2020 as a memorable public-health slogan. Selected as the word of the year ("⟦{流行語|りゅうこうご}→流行語：13307_ryuukougo⟧⟦{大賞|たいしょう}→大賞：12191_taishou⟧") in 2020.

THE THREE COMPONENTS:
- ⟦{密閉|みっぺい}→密閉：19651_mippei⟧⟦{空間|くうかん}→空間：13754_kuukan⟧: poorly ventilated, enclosed spaces
- ⟦{密集|みっしゅう}→密集：12342_misshuu⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧: crowded places
- ⟦{密接|みっせつ}→密接：12289_missetsu⟧⟦{場面|ばめん}→場面：03702_bamen⟧: close-contact situations

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {三密|さんみつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧: avoid the three Cs
- {三密|さんみつ}⟦{回避|かいひ}→回避：11810_kaihi⟧: three-Cs avoidance
- {三密|さんみつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧やすい⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧: places prone to the three Cs
